# B1 CODE gate — Spec / correctness review, attempt 2 of 3

**Verdict: ACCEPT the reviewed correctness remediation. No remaining material Spec blocker found in this bounded follow-up.** This does not establish merge readiness, five-second performance, remaining capability breadth or release readiness.

Baseline remains verified remote main/merge-base `b61a031d0bde0e21d283e0f94975f79b9ae15574`; source HEAD `2e8ab886` plus frozen tracked/untracked B1 changes. All nine #562 manifest paths and all four #563/admission manifest paths match their supplied SHA-256 values. No Cargo, source edits or new experiment was run.

## Prior findings resolved

1. **Complete raw side-boundary rebinding (#562).** `certified_conical/native/side/source.rs` now retains a typed, owned source record for each admitted boundary slot: complete original 2D/3D pole order, stored weight bits, degree/rationality, raw parameter ranges, actual location coefficients and use orientation, plus the side wire orientation. Length-delimited append includes these records in `binding/snapshot.rs::side_bits`; neither pointers nor digest equality carry authority. Geometric side/row/ruling/vertex admission runs first in `native.rs::capture_side`, then the raw source is captured. Thus signed-zero or reversed representations can remain numerically admissible while invalidating an issued receipt. The side geometry/vertex extraction preserves the prior first-failure sequence.

   The new actual-O controls mutate real pcurve range and pole signed zeros, reverse a pcurve and reverse an actual ruling curve. Each requires fresh numeric capture to succeed and old family rebinding to fail; the signed-zero controls additionally require topology/geometry Passed, SI Inconclusive and tolerance NotRun. They restore the original actual sources and require the original receipt to bind again, using the same complete operation result rather than constructing replacement proof fixtures. These exercise the precise source-only counterexamples from review1.

2. **Selected policy admission before later cancellation (#563).** `input::capture_with_selection` delegates rounded/default modes directly to the original capture. Directed mode performs existing scalar/proof/support admission first, then selected-proof eligibility, then source reading. `execute_with_selection` retains the original initial Admission poll. The redundant later eligibility guard grants no new authority/work/poll. This fixes the original V4/late-cancel test without weakening its assertion, preserves initial-cancel and invalid-support precedence, and leaves old default/explicit-V2 numerical statements and callbacks on their original route.

The accompanying `program_trace/binding.rs` extraction preserves checked Direct work addition and zero additional work for Reverse; vertex endpoint extraction preserves loop order and the original offending-value check. No reviewed delta changes the geometric theorems, error allocations, primitive limits, refinement rules or arithmetic accounting.

## Evidence and delivery limits

Recorded metadata compilation and complete-operation terminals both have exit0, `passed:true`, `source_changed:[]`. Selection5/5 includes the unchanged late-cancel regression plus exact old-V2 bytes/history/work/polls. The genuine complete outward/inward O. controls pass2/2 with989,355/1m operations,444 integration cells,148 spans and the unchanged complete public coverage. Math218 and new metadata compile controls supplement this. Six older TKBO ordered controls predate the repair; new actual-native controls cover the changed behavior, and the full canonical affected gate is still required.

Next: preserve this corrected snapshot for broad/canonical/hosted/concurrency qualification and the separate matched performance gate. Diagnostic API13.09/13.39s still exceeds five seconds. Full feature scope remains broader than O.; no version/tag, integration or whole-capability completion authorization follows from this source verdict.

# B1 code Standards recheck — attempt 2 of 3

**Verdict: the round-1 code corrections are resolved; no new scoped Standards blocker found.** This is source acceptance conditional on the remaining canonical/hosted, numerical and performance gates, not complete B1/publication approval.

Frozen HEAD `2e8ab886d4755c9c0165d7f59f2a92ead61f3612`; main merge-base `b61a031d0bde0e21d283e0f94975f79b9ae15574`. Reviewed the round-1 remediation and all nine #562 paths. Refreshed metrics cover 810 main-diff Rust paths, excluding unchanged accepted HEAD bodies; no changed body exceeds 20 physical lines and no Rust file reaches 500 lines. Start/end hashes and all nine supplied #562 hashes agree. New manifest: `/tmp/martensite-b1-code-standards-r2-source-manifest.json`, SHA256 `bd18920fbb8463ef319665d36a811a6d0c143e1dae49fedc6effd3551ea7b42c`. The round-1 receipts are untouched. No Cargo/source edits.

- **#563 admission/cancellation:** `operation/cone/input.rs:14–30` preserves the existing rounded capture and moves directed eligibility after scalar/policy/frame admission but before source capture. `cone/mod.rs:111–112` preserves the initial cancellation poll. The private ancestor visibility correction permits the shared check without new public surface. Root's unchanged selected regression now passes; all 5 selection controls passed, including the old V2 bytes/history/budget/callback comparison.
- **Size/nesting:** `developed_boundary/material.rs` now extracts the actual selected retained-capture lookup. `native/vertices.rs` extracts the per-row endpoint check; `program_trace/binding.rs` extracts the original checked Direct work advance. Original evaluation/error/work order remains and no third control level was introduced in the repair or new #562 batch. The new `raw_source.rs` mutation file's largest body is 18 lines; its 11 helpers remain private and exercised through the existing complete operation.
- **Thread traits:** `actual_certificate/tests/thread_traits.rs:7–32` supplies the 19 missing Math assertions. `certified_conical/ordered/tests.rs:111–120` supplies all 8 TKBO assertions, including the native inputs. Root's all-test metadata check passed with an unchanged dependency source guard.
- **#562 structure/reuse:** the private typed `SideSource` captures raw per-slot 2D/3D source metadata after existing geometric admission and appends it to the existing complete member snapshot. No parallel geometry engine, public stub or default/signature change was added. Mutation controls retain original geometry, demonstrate refusal of stale authority and restore/rebind it through the existing operation.

Root's complete inward/outward controls now pass 2/2 with unchanged guards, including #562 admission/rebinding/ordered-SI controls. Their approximately 13.1/13.4 s diagnostic timings still exceed the 5 s target. Numerical acceptance, matched time/RSS, concurrency/TSan, publication docs and required canonical/hosted checks remain separate gates.
